text: A woman with long, flowing red hair, fair skin, and a slender build sits in profile. Her face is oval, with dark eyes and lips. She wears a white sleeveless top, a blue beaded collar, and a light blue bracelet on her left wrist. One arm rests near her knee; the other is partially visible. Behind her are dark, shadowy figures and objects—possibly armor or statues—with muted purples and grays dominating the background.
